Chapter 6976: Heavencrush

Chapter 6976: Heavencrush

A crystal eaves-tile would only be considered an extravagant building material in any other world. However, this one was an immortal.

The emperors have met demons and other strange races but this took them by surprise. Were all the materials in the fortress this strong?

What was the point of having the highest intelligence then? These stones and rocks still surpassed them.

“Heavenly Fortress wants to play too?” Li Qiye frowned.

This was one of the nine major worlds. Tribulation Daoist and the others had no idea of its immense influence and size.

It had countless cultivators with no lack of supreme overlords and immortals. However, instead of flesh and blood, it had building materials as the ruling inhabitants.

Other races might change form to something more humanoid as they grow stronger. This race chose to stay the same throughout.

For example, a golden brick or a fortress could stay in one spot for epochs. One day, they somehow became immortal.

They maintained a low profile, never interacting with outsiders. Nevertheless, they have never lost dominion of their world.

“May I ask which world you are from?” The immortal eaves-tile asked Li Qiye.

“Whichever.” Li Qiye smiled.

The tile was unhappy with the response but maintained its composure. It asked: “That thing is rather useful to us, would you be willing to give it up?”

This passiveness didn’t match their first interaction. Moreover, it couldn’t see through Li Qiye. The man appeared to be a mortal but a mortal couldn’t come from the outside world to Survivor Realm.

Li Qiye only smiled and didn’t respond.

“You may call me Tile Immortal, what is your title?” It asked.

“No need for you to know.” Li Qiye said.

“We want to know.” The overlord pillar said, confident in its odds.

The tile stopped it and said: “Our Heavenly Fortress race has always been reasonable. What is your demand?”

“Actually, I’m interested in some information, answer adequately and I might give the bone to you.” Li Qiye said.

“Please go on, Fellow Daoist.” The tile said.

“I heard all of you have a master, Lord of Fortress. Who is it?” Li Qiye asked.

“That’s not something for you to ask.” The golden brick shouted.

“I do not know the answer, you can change to a different question.” The tile said.

“I see.” Li Qiye complied: “I know your race also has a machine named Heavencrush. Let me borrow it?”

“You!” The five overlords were enraged.

“Sir, that’s not possible. I myself cannot move it so if you are interested, you can visit our world to see it.” The tile said.

“If I visit your world, it won’t only be to look, I might disassemble and study it.” Li Qiye said.

This time, even the tile’s expression darkened.
